commit.message:
Revert the author addition; keep the affiliation fix and the funding

The planned fifth author will not join this submission after all, so the
byline, the author block, and the citation metadata return to the four
original authors. The corrected affiliation (Zhongyuan Critical Metals
Laboratory) and the four supporting grants remain.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
